title: चार हज़ार करोड़ की रामायण, अब दुनिया देखेगी
description: रामायण दो हिस्सों में बन रही भारत की सबसे महंगी फिल्म है, जिसे सौ से ज़्यादा देशों में दिखाने की तैयारी है। बड़े सपने देखने वाली भारतीय फिल्मों का साथ दीजिए, जय श्री राम।

scenes.narration: क्या आपने सोचा है कि चार हज़ार करोड़ रुपये में बनने वाली फिल्म कैसी होगी?
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Wide cinematic shot inside a grand Indian movie theatre, a crowd of smiling stick characters with smooth white circle heads, dot eyes and thin black stick limbs in colorful kurtas and sarees sitting in rows, all looking up with wonder at a gigantic glowing golden screen that shows a radiant epic landscape with a distant palace, golden light beams streaming from the projector over their faces, popcorn and excitement in the air. Warm golden light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: रामायण, भारत की अब तक की सबसे महंगी फिल्म, जो दो हिस्सों में बन रही है।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Heroic wide shot of Ram, a stick character with a smooth soft sky-blue circle head, dot eyes, a small golden crown, thin black stick limbs, a saffron dhoti and a tall bow in hand, standing beside Sita, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a long black braid, thin black stick limbs and a green saree, two glowing golden film reels floating in the sky above them like two great parts of one epic, a grand ancient Ayodhya palace behind them at sunrise. Warm golden light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: ये चार हज़ार करोड़ दोनों हिस्सों का बजट है, रिलीज़ और प्रमोशन मिलाकर।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. A stick character producer with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, standing in a film studio next to two tall glowing stacks of golden coins, one for each film, a movie camera on a tripod, a huge megaphone and a small rocket symbol for promotion beside him, soft studio lights and a large painted epic backdrop behind. Warm golden light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: हॉलीवुड जब बड़ी फिल्म बनाता है, तो पूरी दुनिया देखने जाती है।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. A glowing globe in the middle of the frame with stick characters of many nations, with smooth white circle heads, dot eyes and thin black stick limbs, wearing different traditional and modern clothes, all walking happily toward a bright cinema hall with a glowing marquee, a Hollywood-style spotlight sweeping the night sky, warm festive evening light. Warm golden light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: तो हमारी अपनी कहानी, हमारी रामायण, दुनिया तक क्यों नहीं पहुँचे?
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. A proud stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, thin black stick limbs and a saffron kurta, standing on a hilltop holding up a glowing ancient scroll that releases golden light and floating lotus petals across the sky toward a far horizon with many tiny cities and lights, a hopeful sunrise, a sense of a story travelling across the world. Warm golden light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: ये फिल्म सौ से ज़्यादा देशों में रिलीज़ होने की तैयारी में है।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. A large glowing world map style globe seen from space with many bright golden dots lighting up across continents, stick characters of different countries with smooth white circle heads, dot eyes and thin black stick limbs waving happily from small cinema halls on the globe, an Indian tricolour ribbon of light flowing around the planet, soft stars in the background. Warm golden light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: बड़ा बजट सिर्फ पैसा नहीं है, ये भरोसा है कि भारतीय सिनेमा दुनिया के मंच पर खड़ा हो सकता है।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. A tall stick character filmmaker with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, standing confidently on a grand stage under a bright spotlight with a vintage movie camera in his hands, a huge audience of stick characters from many nations applauding in the dark hall, golden confetti falling, a sense of pride and confidence. Warm golden light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: इसलिए इस पहल की तारीफ़ बनती है।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. A group of five smiling stick characters with smooth white circle heads, dot eyes and thin black stick limbs in colorful Indian clothes clapping and cheering together on a rooftop at sunset, a few holding diyas and a small flag, a glowing film reel rising in the sky like the sun behind them, warm festive mood. Warm golden light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: थिएटर में जाइए, विदेश में बैठे दोस्तों को बताइए, और ऐसी बड़ी भारतीय फिल्मों का साथ दीजिए।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. A stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, thin black stick limbs and a faded blue kurta, holding a glowing cinema ticket in one hand and a phone in the other, a bright video call bubble beside him showing two smiling stick friends in another country with a snowy city behind them, a glowing theatre entrance and golden light behind him. scenes.narration: जय श्री राम। इसे हर उस दोस्त को भेजो जो भारतीय सिनेमा पर गर्व करता है।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Two stick friends in the foreground, one with a faded blue kurta and one with a maroon kurta, smiling and standing close, one holding a small glowing golden heart toward the other, in the sky behind them a soft glowing silhouette of Ram with a bow and Sita among flower petals and a rising golden sun, a distant Ayodhya temple glowing.
